description: One Forever serve slot standing in Uldaman: A looks up the altar (game object entry 133234), uses it and its event log carries a gameobject change. The altar's ritual needs its other users nearby (the module ticket), so the state change follows them; the summoning half is forever-ritual-summon. use_object's own result names the object, and the run's only gameobject event is the altar's.

steps.title: A finds the altar in its view
A uses the altar; its log carries a gameobject change
